meta.name: how-it-works
meta.description: Explain how claude-mem captures observations, when memory injection kicks in, and where data lives. Use when the user asks "how does claude-mem work?" or "what is this thing doing?".

howto.what: Claude 会把每次读文件、编辑、运行命令的行为压缩成观察记录,在会话结束时汇总;以后开会话时,相关的旧记录会自动加到提示里,让你接着上次的上下文继续。
howto.when: 从项目里的第二次会话开始,自动注入相关记忆。第一次会话负责积累记忆;也可以主动运行 /learn-codebase 一次性把整个仓库读进记忆(约5分钟,可选)。

say.note: 会得到捕获、注入和数据存储位置的解释。

say.text: 这个项目上次做到哪了?
say.note: 触发注入上次相关记忆,快速恢复上下文。

say.text: 帮我用 /learn-codebase 记住整个代码库
say.note: 主动把整个仓库加载进记忆,约需5分钟。

howto.what_en: Claude turns each Read, Edit, and Bash action into a compressed observation. Observations are summarized at session end, and relevant ones are auto-injected into future prompts so the next session starts with context from the last one.
howto.when_en: Memory injection starts from the second session in a project; the first session seeds memory. You can also run /learn-codebase to load the whole repo at once (~5 min, optional).

say_en.note: Explains capture, injection, and data location.

say_en.text: Where did we leave off last time?
say_en.note: Triggers injection of relevant past memory.

say_en.text: Use /learn-codebase to memorize the whole repo
say_en.note: Actively loads the repo into memory, ~5 min.
